body: **Summary** ### [FX-2966](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2966) **Result** Ultimately chose to put defaults in `reset.scss`, it may be sort of big relatively to the file but takes up less space than the range slider, and it's still small relative to the overall size of InstantSearch. - `reset` sets defaults for the carousel, it should be a grid with a horizontal scrollbar and centered buttons on each side on hover. Navigation buttons are unstyled. - Each theme then styles the buttons, and sets spacing and colors. I only used colors from their respective palettes. (I added red background and height to each item to make gaps and size obvious) `reset`: `algolia`: `satellite`: [FX-2966]: https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-2966?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
